title: Combined-Program Credit on Pre-K Tuition: Amount for the Month
content:
**Clause.** For a tuition-based Pre-K child of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days), the combined-program credit is figured as follows.

1. The credit is worked out for the enrollment's most recent billing month: the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge. It is read from the child's Creek Kids Club enrollment in status active on the Pre-K Wraparound plan, as that enrollment stands on the day the credit is posted.
2. The combined-program credit is 40.00 for the month.
3. A child without a Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) enrollment in status active has no combined-program credit at all, and nothing is booked.
4. The credit is never more than that month's tuition charge.
5. Every amount the board's combined-program schedule sets is applied to the 40.00 credit in one order: first amounts that take its place, then multipliers, then amounts added and amounts taken off, never taking the credit below zero, then the limit to the month's tuition charge. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Judging a month

| The child, on the day the credit is posted | Credit for the most recent billing month |
|---|---|
| holds a Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) enrollment in status active | 40.00, but never more than that month's tuition charge |
| holds a Pre-K Wraparound enrollment in any status other than active | none |
| holds only another Creek Kids Club plan, such as After-School Care | none |
| holds no Creek Kids Club enrollment | none |

## The limit (hypothetical month)

Where a most recent billing month's tuition charge were a hypothetical 30.00, a credit figured at 40.00 would be limited to 30.00, the month's tuition charge.
